verdict.rationale: Railway's own docs say you connect a Git repo and Railway handles deployment, and that every pull request gets its own preview deployment. That points to Git-triggered deploys, but no evidence explicitly says deploys run automatically on every push to a branch. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of push-triggered auto-deploy on branches, branch/trigger configuration docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest.
Every pull request gets its own preview.
